meta.verification_note: Only the rules listed in verified_rule_ids were checked line by line against the official CAQM PDF. The others were transcribed by hand and should be re-checked before real use.
meta.note: Decision support only. The official CAQM order prevails. Stages are cumulative: higher stages add to lower ones (Schedule para 4).
emergency_services: Medical services (hospital / nursing home / health care)
Projects related to national security, defence and national importance

rules.title: Dust mitigation at C&D sites
rules.summary: C&D materials and waste must be stored and covered, transported only in covered vehicles, and the site must use anti-smog guns and water sprinkling.
rules.fix: Cover stored materials and waste, use covered vehicles, run anti-smog guns and sprinkle water.
rules.authority: CPCB, DPCC and SPCBs; Urban Local Bodies; construction agencies and plot owners

rules.title: Web-portal registration for sites of 500 sqm or more
rules.summary: C&D activity is not permitted for projects with plot size of 500 sqm or more that are not registered on the State / GNCTD web portal and / or do not meet the other requirements of Direction Nos. 11-18 dated 11.06.2021. Niyam checks portal registration only. Confirm the other requirements separately.
rules.fix: Register the project on the State / GNCTD web portal and meet the remote dust-monitoring requirements of Direction Nos. 11-18 dated 11.06.2021.
rules.authority: CPCB, DPCC and SPCBs; Urban Local Bodies; construction agencies and plot owners

rules.title: Listed dust-generating C&D activities
rules.summary: Strict restrictions across the entire NCR on: excavation, filling, boring and drilling; piling; all demolition; open-trench laying of sewer, water, drainage and cabling; brick / masonry work; RMC batching plant; major welding and gas-cutting; painting, polishing and varnishing; cement, plaster and other coatings; cutting, grinding and fixing of tiles, stone and flooring; road construction and major repairs; transfer, loading and unloading of dust-generating materials (cement, fly-ash, bricks, sand, murram, pebbles, crushed stone); and movement of vehicles carrying construction materials or C&D waste on unpaved roads.
exceptions: Minor welding for MEP works is permitted.
Minor indoor repairs / maintenance are excepted for plaster / coatings and for tile, stone and flooring work.
Other construction activities not on the list are permitted, subject to the C&D Waste Management Rules and dust control norms.

All C&D activity continues for: railway services and stations; metro rail and stations; airports and inter-state bus terminals; national security / defence / national importance projects; hospitals and health care facilities; linear public projects (highways, roads, flyovers, over bridges, power transmission / distribution, pipelines, telecom); sanitation projects (sewage treatment plants, water supply); and ancillary activities specific to these.
Linear public projects lose this exception at Stage IV (see C-S4-01).
rules.fix: Pause the listed activities until the stage is lowered, or confirm whether the project falls in an exempt category.
rules.authority: NCR State Governments and GNCTD; CPCB, DPCC and SPCBs; Urban Local Bodies; construction agencies and plot owners

rules.title: Stage III C&D ban extends to linear public projects
rules.summary: The Stage III C&D ban also applies to linear public projects such as highways, roads, flyovers, overbridges, power transmission, pipelines and telecommunication.
rules.fix: Pause the listed activities on linear public projects until the stage is lowered.
rules.authority: CPCB, DPCC and SPCBs; Urban Local Bodies; nodal officers of road-owning agencies

rules.title: Over-aged diesel / petrol vehicles
rules.summary: The NGT / Supreme Court ban on plying over-aged diesel and petrol vehicles is to be strictly enforced.
rules.fix: Do not use over-aged vehicles. Replace them with a compliant vehicle.
rules.authority: Transport Departments of Delhi and NCR States; Traffic Police

rules.title: BS-III petrol and BS-IV diesel light motor vehicles
rules.summary: Strict restrictions on plying BS-III petrol and BS-IV diesel (or below) LMVs (4-wheelers) in Delhi and in the High Vehicle Density districts of Gurugram, Faridabad, Sonipat, Ghaziabad and Gautam Budha Nagar.
exceptions: Persons with Disabilities may ply such LMVs if specifically adapted for them and used only for personal use.
rules.fix: Use a BS-VI, CNG or electric vehicle instead.
rules.authority: State Governments in NCR and GNCTD; Transport Commissioners; Traffic Police

rules.title: Delhi-registered diesel BS-IV and below medium goods vehicles
rules.summary: Strict restrictions on plying Delhi-registered diesel BS-IV and below medium goods vehicles (MGVs) in Delhi.
rules.fix: Use a BS-VI, CNG or electric goods vehicle.
rules.authority: State Governments in NCR and GNCTD; Transport Commissioners; Traffic Police

rules.title: Outside-Delhi diesel BS-IV and below MGVs and LGVs entering Delhi
rules.summary: Diesel BS-IV and below medium goods vehicles and light goods vehicles registered outside Delhi are not permitted to enter Delhi.
rules.fix: Use a BS-VI, CNG or electric goods vehicle for deliveries into Delhi.
rules.authority: GNCTD; Transport Commissioners; Urban Local Bodies; Traffic Police

rules.title: Heavy goods vehicles (trucks) in Delhi
rules.summary: Entry of trucks (HGVs) into Delhi is stopped, and Delhi-registered diesel BS-IV and below HGVs are banned from plying in Delhi.
exceptions: LNG / CNG / electric / BS-VI diesel trucks are permitted.
rules.fix: Use an LNG, CNG, electric or BS-VI diesel truck.
rules.authority: State Governments in NCR and GNCTD; Transport Commissioners; Urban Local Bodies; Traffic Police

rules.title: Open burning of biomass and municipal solid waste
rules.summary: Open burning of bio-mass and municipal solid waste is prohibited. Maximum Environmental Compensation is imposed on violations as per NGT orders dated 04.12.2014 and 28.04.2015 in OA 21/2014.
rules.fix: Stop burning. Send waste to designated collection points.
rules.authority: CPCB, DPCC and SPCBs; Urban Local Bodies

rules.title: Illegal dumping of waste
rules.summary: No MSW, C&D, industrial or hazardous waste may be dumped illegally in open land. Waste must be lifted regularly from dedicated dump sites and industrial areas.
rules.fix: Dispose of waste only at designated sites and arrange regular lifting.
rules.authority: CPCB, DPCC and SPCBs; Urban Local Bodies; DMs / DCs; land-owning and construction agencies

rules.title: RWAs must provide electric heaters to staff
rules.summary: Resident Welfare Associations must provide electric heaters (with electricity supply point) to staff in security, sanitation, horticulture and other services, to avoid open biomass / MSW burning in winter.
rules.fix: Provide electric heaters with a power point to security, sanitation and horticulture staff.

rules.title: DG sets as a regular power source
rules.summary: Diesel generator sets must not be used as a regular source of power supply.
rules.fix: Use grid power, with the DG set only as backup.
rules.authority: CPCB, DPCC and SPCBs; Urban Local Bodies; DMs / DCs

rules.title: DG sets of 800 kW (1000 kVA) and above
rules.summary: Diesel DG sets of 800 kW (1000 kVA) and above must have an emission control system / mechanism and comply with the emission standards in Direction No. 76 dated 29.09.2023. The order's table lists the GSR 804(E) exemption only up to 800 kW (1000 kVA), so Niyam treats GSR-compliant sets above that size like older sets.
exceptions: Gas-based sets (LPG / natural gas / bio-gas / propane / butane) of any capacity have no restriction.
DG sets up to 800 kW (1000 kVA) that meet MoEFCC notification GSR 804(E) dated 03.11.2022 have no restriction.
rules.fix: Fit an emission control system and comply with Direction No. 76 standards, or switch to a gas-based set, or to a GSR 804(E)-compliant set of up to 1000 kVA.
rules.authority: CPCB, DPCC and SPCBs; Urban Local Bodies; DMs / DCs
rules.clause: Stage I, Action 18 (table), Direction No. 76 dated 29.09.2023

rules.title: Older-spec DG sets of 41 kW (51 kVA) to below 800 kW (1000 kVA)
rules.summary: These sets must run in dual-fuel mode or be retro-fitted with emission control devices through certified agencies. A set that is not dual-fuel only because gas infrastructure or supply is unavailable is permitted only for the emergency services.
exceptions: Gas-based sets and GSR 804(E)-compliant sets have no restriction.
Permitted for the emergency services if not dual-fuel only due to gas unavailability.
rules.fix: Convert to dual-fuel or retro-fit certified emission control devices.
rules.authority: CPCB, DPCC and SPCBs; Urban Local Bodies; DMs / DCs

rules.title: Older-spec DG sets of 19 kW (23 kVA) to below 41 kW (51 kVA)
rules.summary: These sets must run in dual-fuel mode. A set that is not dual-fuel only because gas infrastructure or supply is unavailable is permitted only for the emergency services.
exceptions: Gas-based sets and GSR 804(E)-compliant sets have no restriction.
Permitted for the emergency services if not dual-fuel only due to gas unavailability.
rules.authority: CPCB, DPCC and SPCBs; Urban Local Bodies; DMs / DCs

rules.title: Portable DG sets below 19 kW (23 kVA)
rules.summary: No specific means of emission control are available in this range, so these sets are not generally permitted.
exceptions: Permitted only for the prescribed emergency services (see meta.emergency_services).
rules.fix: Use grid power or a gas-based set. Keep a portable set only for an emergency service.
rules.authority: CPCB, DPCC and SPCBs; Urban Local Bodies; DMs / DCs
